time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t*24); frame 0 .. 49 (t 0 .. 2.0417 s)

camera.view: fronto-parallel view of a living-room wall; floor visible at the bottom; the cat walks left->right parallel to the wall/image plane in front of the furniture
camera.perspective: essentially none for in-plane motion; cat path is horizontal at constant depth (paw contact line y~1020 every frame, apparent body length constant ~245 px)

cat.desc: black cat with white paws/socks, white-grey face/chest, tail raised upright; the only moving object
cat.occluded: never (it walks in front of bench and TV stand); its long shadow falls to the right onto the TV stand / floor
cat.reference_point: torso_cx, torso_cy = centroid of the body blob (fur mask opened with 31 px ellipse: body+head, no legs/tail/ears) - best proxy for the rig root/pelvis horizontal position; root likely sits nearer the hips, but for horizontal walking speed all body points move together
cat.recommended_position_columns: body_x_matched / body_y_matched (cumulative upper-body shape-matching shifts, anchored at torso centroid of frame 0; per-frame step noise ~1 px) for speeds; torso_cx/torso_cy (centroid, per-frame noise ~3-5 px from leg/neck shape changes) as a cross-check

bench.desc: wooden slatted side table/bench at far left, lower shelf, 4 splayed legs

tv_stand.desc: long dark wood media console with black curved metal legs, centre

tv.desc: black flat-screen TV on the stand

vase.desc: white/blue patterned ceramic vase on the left end of the stand

lamp.desc: table lamp with pleated white conical shade and copper base, right end of stand

mirror.desc: tall floor mirror in light wooden frame leaning against the wall, far right

floor.desc: light tan floor; cat paw contact line y ~1020; wall/floor junction behind furniture ~y 950-968

window_light.desc: sunlit patches and diagonal window-frame shadows on the wall (static)

events.motion: cat walks at roughly steady pace for the whole clip (frames 0-49); no start, stop, turn, jump or contact events
events.gait: torso_cy oscillates by ~10 px; local minima (body highest) near frames 6, 15, 24, 34, 43 -> stride period ~9.3 frames (~0.39 s)
events.passes: cat in front of bench legs frames 0-~12; in front of TV stand from ~frame 15 on (body x 650-1423)
